summary: Iteration 9 — Full regression on BATCH: premium 3D-glass redesign + security hardening. Backend: 9/9 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_batch9_hardening.py — (1) /api/auth/me unauth → 200 {user:null}, (2) /api/fans/me unauth → 200 {user:null}, (3) Cache-Control contains 'no-store' + X-Robots-Tag 'noindex' on /api/auth/*, (4) admin login with cristimf2007@gmail.com / mfcristi2007! works and sets httpOnly cookie, (5) /api/tv/schedule add Saturday (day=5) → list → delete flow with cleanup leaving GET /api/tv/schedule intact, (6) POST /api/admin/tv/schedule requires auth (401), (7) /api/fans/register rejects invalid email, (8) fan login lockout after 5 fails → 429 'Prea multe încercări. Reîncearcă în 15 minute.', (9) middleware strict auth rate limit 10 POST/min/IP triggers 429 within 12 fast attempts. Frontend (desktop 1920x1080): / renders all 8 expected testids (noutati-page, hero-live-badge, hero-paypal, hero-discord, home-clips, home-tracks, bio-section, news-feed) with ZERO 401s and ZERO console errors — security goal met. /tv has tv-stage, tv-bigplay, tv-guide, tvg-tab-0..6, tv-chat; clicking tv-bigplay drives state machine idle → tv-logo-intro (2s) → tv-promo-chip (promo) → tv-intro-skip → tv-live-badge appears playing; no tv-error chip observed (live HLS actually decoded in this run). /muzica radio audio paused=True by default (no autoplay). /clipuri loads without 401s. Admin (/admin): login via cristimf2007@gmail.com succeeds with 'Salut, boss!' toast, tracks grid renders 6 tracks with cover thumbnails, admin-tv-day select present (values 0..6/''), programmatically selecting day=5 and submitting TEST_UI_batch9 added & deleted a schedule row via admin-tv-del-<id>. Mobile 390x844: both / and /tv have scrollWidth==clientWidth (no horizontal overflow), bottom nav visible, hero/TV player stack correctly. Note: admin-track-cover-<id> testid is on the <label> wrapper (Admin.jsx:359) not the <input>; feature is present and clickable (verified visually in screenshot — cover thumbnails next to every track).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/auth/me and /api/fans/me now gracefully return 200 {user:null} for logged-out visitors — eliminates 401 console noise on public pages. Verified in browser (0 x 401 responses on /, /tv, /muzica, /clipuri).
Middleware correctly applies no-store + noindex on /api/auth/* and global X-Frame-Options/CSP/HSTS headers on all /api responses.
Fan login lockout logic (5 fails → 15min) and register throttle (5/hour/IP) use the same login_attempts collection — simple, correct, covered by tests.

Strict auth middleware (10 POST/min/IP, _AUTH_STRICT_PATHS) works but will aggressively block legit retries during E2E runs — testing scripts must pace auth requests. This matches the explicit note from E1.
TvScheduleInput validates HH:MM pattern, 100-char title clipping, and 0 ≤ day ≤ 6 — clean. The GET endpoint strips _id correctly (projection {_id:0}).

Admin.jsx:359 — data-testid='admin-track-cover-<id>' is correctly placed on the clickable <label>; the file input is nested inside (hidden). Automated tests should query 'label[data-testid^=admin-track-cover-]'.

TvBroadcast.jsx state machine (idle→logo 2s→promo max 4→live) verified behaviorally; tv-intro-skip jumps directly to live. In this preview session the H.264 live stream actually decoded in headless, which is a nice bonus but shouldn't be relied on by future tests.
test_credentials: Super admin cristimf2007@gmail.com / mfcristi2007! verified. No new fan accounts created this iteration (strict rate limits make repeated register unsafe in test runs).
seed_data_creation: Only ephemeral TEST_batch9_* and TEST_UI_batch9 schedule rows were created and immediately deleted by tests. GET /api/tv/schedule is [] after completion (confirmed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_batch9_hardening.py is self-cleaning (clears login_attempts before/after each test; deletes schedule entries it creates). Beware: the strict auth middleware limit (10 POST/min/IP) is global, so running test_batch9_hardening.py and test_security_hardening.py back-to-back will trip 429s — space them out ~60s or run one at a time. All 9 batch features (redesigned home/TV/chat/login modal, admin day-of-week schedule, per-track cover upload endpoint, auth/me+fans/me graceful null, fan lockout, register throttle, strict auth rate limit, no-store/noindex headers, logo-alt.png image fallback — not directly testable server-side but present in frontend) are green.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs to RCA this iteration.
